title: Allegiant
author: Veronica Roth
summary: The third Divergent book is told alternately by Tris and Four. Having grown up in a Chicago divided by personality, they now look beyond the city's borders for answers. It continues directly from the previous book.
readIf: you have followed the Divergent series and want to see how its big questions are answered.
skipIf: you have not read Divergent and Insurgent, since the plot depends on them and the ending divides readers.

pairings.reason: The model for this kind of young-adult dystopia, with a sharper and more lasting impact.
A short, quiet story that questions a controlled society, with similar themes.
A newer dystopian young-adult series with moral dilemmas and a fresh, darker premise.
